## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_15m):anomalies(sum:azure.storage_storageaccounts.transactions{__SCOPE__,response_type:throttlingerror} by {subscription_name,name}.as_rate(), 'agile', 3) >= 1
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-cloud-platform-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-azure-resource` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `azure_resource_health`, `azure_activity_log`, `quota_state`.

Attached to the alert automatically: Azure Resource Health, activity log for the resource, quota headroom.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `cloud-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
